import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if w <= 3:
        print("YES")
        return
    base = w
    cur = m
    ok = True
    while cur != 0:
        r = cur % base
        if r == 0:
            digit = 0
        elif r == 1:
            digit = 1
        elif r == base - 1:
            digit = -1
        else:
            ok = False
            break
        cur = (cur - digit) // base
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
